metadata.description: Dim Sum Dev's own mods (project-scope Claude Code plugins). Mods trial: see .scratch/mods-trial/spec.md.

plugins.name: den
plugins.description: Dim Sum Dev roles (agents and skills) for target projects: install it where `--plugin-dir <den>/.claude` isn't possible, such as claude-code-action in a project's CI.

plugins.name: den-roles
plugins.description: The den's roles for a project's GitHub Actions: `@claude <role>` on a pull request runs that role. Role files only, generated by scripts/den-roles-sync.mjs.

plugins.name: sleep-guard
plugins.description: Blocks sleep-chain Bash commands and points to gh pr checks --watch or Monitor.

plugins.name: test-run-guard
plugins.description: Blocks uncapped node --test runs over globs, directories or many files, and points to npm run test:path.

plugins.name: north-star
plugins.description: A band above the prompt counting down to den v1: bar, done/total and the next critical-path ticket.

plugins.name: queue
plugins.description: A band above the prompt showing what is in flight and the next 3 queued tickets (proposed order, else top of ready).
